info.title: Workeasy Campaign API
info.description: Browser API. Cookie session + X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. Errors use one shape (Error). Organization/workspace routes answer 404 to non-members and 403 to members lacking the permission.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Confirm email with the emailed token
Set a new password; signs out every session
Change password; signs out other sessions

get.summary: Current organization, workspace and effective permissions

post.summary: Create organization + first workspace (requires verified email)

delete.summary: Delete organization (type its name to confirm)

put.summary: Add member to workspace or change their role

post.summary: Accept (signed in as the invited, verified email)
Bulk action on selected or filtered contacts (action-specific permission)

patch.summary: Update profile and custom fields (optimistic version)

post.summary: Permanently erase personal data (GDPR); consent evidence kept per retention policy
Add an email, phone, WhatsApp or external identity

delete.summary: Remove an identity (not the last email/phone)

put.summary: Set a topic preference (recorded as evidence)

delete.summary: Delete list and its memberships (contacts kept)

get.summary: Topics and categories with subscriber counts

post.summary: Suppress a contact or an address
Explain whether contacts can receive a message on a channel
Predict the outcome without changing contacts
Start (after a dry run); runs in the background
Resume a failed or stalled import from its checkpoint
